gloss: out of the question; beyond consideration

definitions.gloss: out of the question; beyond consideration
definitions.explanation: Something so unacceptable or unreasonable that it is not even worth discussing. Often used to flatly reject a proposal or to condemn behavior as inexcusable.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧⟦{提案|ていあん}→提案：03536_teian⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{問題外|もんだいがい}だ。
examples.english: A proposal like that is out of the question.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遅刻|ちこく}して→遅刻する：22282_chikokusuru⟧⟦{謝|あやま}らない→謝る：01177_ayamaru⟧⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧{問題外|もんだいがい}だ。
examples.english: Showing up late and not apologizing is beyond consideration.
The idea of doubling the budget is out of the question for the company right now.

notes:
Used to dismiss something as not even worth considering. Almost always appears as {問題外|もんだいがい}だ or {問題外|もんだいがい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {問題外|もんだいがい}だ: to be out of the question
- まったく{問題外|もんだいがい}: completely out of the question

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{論外|ろんがい}→論外：29289_rongai⟧: out of the question — very close in meaning, slightly more formal
- ⟦ありえない→ありえない：09436_arienai⟧: unthinkable; impossible — more colloquial
